headline: 🔥 **THE $999K REPRICE HAS NOW BOUGHT A THIRD SHOWING — AND 2127 HWY 93 HAS GONE FROM TWO TOURS IN FORTY DAYS TO FIVE IN THIRTY HOURS.** At **3:01 PM today** Ty T. of Keller Williams Homewood booked **Fri 9/4 4:30–5:30 PM**, his first visit, a full hour — making Friday a **double** alongside Sarah J. of ARC Realty–Hoover at 8:30 AM. ⭐ **THE COUNTER IS THE ARGUMENT:** total showings on this house reads **5**, and it read **2** on Sunday. 📞 **BUT THE ONE READ THAT WOULD SETTLE THE PRICE IS STILL MISSING** — Cathy O. walked it Monday 3:45–4:45 PM, the only tour ever held at $999,000, and has filed nothing in about **25 hours**. ⏳ **AND TOUR #21 ON 355 COMANCHE JUST ENDED** — Chad B. of RE/MAX Advantage held 4:30–5:30 this afternoon with the agreement expiring **9/8**, seven days out. His read is worth more tonight than it will ever be again. 📬 **FIVE FEEDBACK ASKS ARE STILL WAITING ON YOU**, two offices asking twice. One reply session clears the column.
